text: {"sql": "SELECT kind, cause, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost, ROUND(AVG(downtime_min), 1) AS avg_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN false_alarm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS false_alarm_count FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE station_id = 'F10' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY kind, cause, shift_code ORDER BY total_downtime_min DESC", "columns": ["kind", "cause", "shift_code", "incident_count", "total_downtime_min", "total_cars_lost", "avg_downtime_min", "false_alarm_count"], "purpose": "Aggregate F10 incidents Jul-Oct 2026 by kind, cause, and shift to surface recurring stop patterns"}

data.sql: SELECT kind, cause, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost, ROUND(AVG(downtime_min), 1) AS avg_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN false_alarm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS false_alarm_count FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE station_id = 'F10' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY kind, cause, shift_code ORDER BY total_downtime_min DESC
data.purpose: Aggregate F10 incidents Jul-Oct 2026 by kind, cause, and shift to surface recurring stop patterns
